resources.string: Set permission to access SMS to use this app.
Forwarding is ON for approved Meta codes only.
Forwarding is OFF. Configure the Worker URL and at least one exact sender ID in Settings. Nothing is forwarded until then.
SMS permission is required. Grant it to use this app.

Approved senders: %1$d
Worker host: %2$s
Accepted events forwarded: %3$d
Device ID: %4$s
HTTPS only, path must be exactly /sms/meta. This is the only network destination the app will ever use.
Exact sender IDs only. Matching is exact and case-insensitive, with no wildcards or partial matches. Leave empty to forward nothing.
Hidden. Tap Show to reveal it once, then enter it in your own terminal with wrangler secret put. Never paste it into a chat.
This secret authenticates this phone to your Worker. Anyone with it can send fake codes. Show it only on this phone, copy it into your own terminal, and never share it in a chat, screenshot or file.
Secret copied. Paste it into your own terminal only.
The old secret stops working immediately. You must set the new secret on the Worker before any code will be accepted again.
New secret generated. Update the Worker secret before codes will be accepted.

Senders seen on this phone while the allowlist is empty. Sender IDs only, no message bodies, stored only on this phone and never uploaded. Tap one to add it to the allowlist field, then Save to approve it manually. A sender is never trusted automatically.
Sender added to the field. Tap Save to approve it.
Use an https URL whose path is exactly /sms/meta, with no query or fragment.
Wildcards are not allowed. Enter the exact sender ID.
A sender ID must not contain spaces. Enter the exact sender ID.
